reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: §13.1 extends the subscription right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (plus Authorized Users), closing the affiliate/contractor gap the rule targets.

§13.2 grants a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence for paid-up/embedded software and Vendor Technology to Customer and its Affiliates, with contractor support expressly permitted — matching the preferred position on paid-up licences.

§13.3 limits revocation/suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure period, so no at-will revocability remains, and it permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor via the Section 24 assignment right, satisfying the transferability element.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected or present for a compliant finding, and both deterministic checks (affiliate coverage; no at-will revocation) pass, corroborating the rationale.
